title: Reply
description: From Core. To an operator interface, once for every message the operator sends (after its hello): accepted, or refused with an explanation, such as a command kind the Asset does not list in its hello. reply_to is the operator message's seq. For a query, Core sends the answer first and the reply last, so the reply marks the end of the answer. Refusals include a command to an Asset that is not connected (Core does not hold it). asset_id is set when that message concerned one Asset. Accepted means Core passed it on; the Asset's reports (task status, report.settings) confirm the effect. To an Asset, accepted acknowledges a final task report (completed, failed or cancelled), reply_to that report's seq; the Asset resends the report until it gets this. A retried message gets the same reply again, unchanged.
